What the Blue Wave in Texas Means for Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX

Watch WSJ’s Becky Peterson explain what’s next for Musk’s projects in the Lone Star State

By

and

Texas turned blue in 2026, with voters rejecting the GOP leaders who greeted Elon Musk and his businesses with open arms when he fled California in 2020.

So with a new crop of Democratic officials set to take over Texas in January, what’s next for the world’s richest man in the Lone Star State? Watch the video above to find out what Musk stands to lose in Texas after spending hundreds of millions of dollars to sway midterm elections.
